title: XLT-DeluxeCoinflipAddon
description: An addon for XLTournaments to add DeluxeCoinflip objective.
body:
This addon adds a new objective for the plugin XLTournaments & DeluxeCoinflip to allow a tournament that tracks the number of wins a user has in DeluxeCoinflip


# Requires:
[XLTournaments](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/xltournaments-%E2%9C%85-ultimate-global-tournament-plugin-%E2%AD%90-25-objective-types-1-20.70630/)

[DeluxeCoinflip](https://builtbybit.com/resources/deluxecoinflip.10475/)


# Configuration:
To use this objective, create a new tournament and set the objective type to `DELUXECOINFLIP_WIN`
